_comment: Vendored dependencies — no npm runtime packages. Use `scripts/vendor-update.sh blamejs <tag>` to update.
_about: blamejs.shop vendors a single framework — blamejs — which itself bundles every server-side crypto/identity dependency. The transitive packages blamejs ships are surfaced in its own MANIFEST.json at lib/vendor/blamejs/lib/vendor/MANIFEST.json — Trivy / Grype rely on that nested data for CVE attribution.

blamejs.author: blamejs contributors
blamejs._about: The Node framework blamejs.shop builds on, unpacked at lib/vendor/blamejs/ from the signed release tarball published for the tag below. The refresh verifies the tarball's SHA3-512 digest and its ML-DSA-65 signature against the upstream release key pinned at keys/vendor-blamejs-pqc-pub.json, and refuses to write anything here if either check fails. Run `npm run vendor blamejs <vX.Y.Z>` to refresh.
blamejs.bundler: signed release tarball blamejs-core-0.21.8.tgz from github.com/blamejs/blamejs — SHA3-512 digest and ML-DSA-65 signature verified against keys/vendor-blamejs-pqc-pub.json before unpacking
